{{Quote|Usual Arterial Blocker, Sergeant Kal? Extra egg?''"<br />"''Please.|[[Soronna]] and [[Kal Skirata]]|<ref name="TC" />}}
The "'''Arterial Blocker'''" was the name of a greasy breakfast [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] served at the [[Kragget/Legends|Kragget]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="TC" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The Arterial Blocker included fried [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] and smoked [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] slices.<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> The dish became a favorite of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Mercenary/Legends|military contractor]] [[Kal Skirata]], a regular customer of the Kragget during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TC" /> The Kragget's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]], [[Soronna]],<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> knew the Arterial Blocker was a usual order of Skirata's, who preferred to order an extra egg with the meal.<ref name="TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Arterial Blocker first appeared, unnamed, in the [[2006]] ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Republic Commando: Triple Zero|''Triple Zero'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TZ" /> ''Triple Zero''{{'s}} [[2007]] sequel, [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']], introduced the Arterial Blocker name.<ref name="TC" />
